title: PR-0B: Event and Replay Semantics (Section 26A)
summary: Implement Section 26A's eventId-based idempotency, causationRef/correlationRef enforcement, and replay capability for derived state, per ADR-0021's PR-0B authorization, now unblocked with PR-0A merged.
EventLog is a minimal, generic append-only log keyed solely on eventId -- a duplicate delivery is a documented no-op, not an error and not a second transition.

buildAggregateActivityProjection is a pure reducer proving replay: derived state built purely from the canonical event log, validated by a fixture that deletes a projection and confirms replay reconstructs it byte-for-byte equivalent.
risk: Low: new, additive orchestration module and its unit tests only; no existing schema, event vocabulary entry, routing behavior, or public page changes.
AggregateActivityProjection is deliberately a minimal, generic derived-state shape used only to exercise the replay mechanism -- not a new Phase 1.6 canonical entity.
testEvidence: npm run test passes 289/289, including 14 new unit tests in decision-os-event-replay.test.ts covering idempotency, causation/correlation enforcement (including Section 26A's own worked ADRAccepted/DecisionPackageCreated example), and the literal byte-for-byte replay fixture Section 31's PR-0B exit evidence names.
npm run format:check and npm run lint pass with no findings.
npm run ci:prepublish result for this candidate is bound to the candidate SHA and appended to the published PR body.
documentationImpact: None: this PR implements only the design/test scope ADR-0021 already authorized and documented; no plan, decision, or architecture page changes.
rollback: Revert this bounded commit through the protected pull-request workflow.
No schema migration, runtime wiring, routing behavior change, or business-data change is introduced; rollback has no production impact.
